data: Does the brown line start at a value lower than 12?

The brown line represents the most frequent strategy in the figure. The y-axis of the graph is labeled as "BLEU," which measures the performance of the strategies. The x-axis represents the average vocabulary size per sentence. The brown line starts at approximately 12 on the y-axis, which corresponds to the value of 12 on the y-axis scale. Therefore, the brown line does not start at a value lower than 12.
